info.description: Experimental HttpApi surface for selected instance routes.

get.description: Check whether the API server is ready to accept requests.
Resolve the requested location or the server default location.
Retrieve currently registered agents.

schema.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to the newest 50 sessions.
Session order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.
Only return root sessions (sessions without a parent).

anyOf.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

post.description: Create a session at the requested location.

get.description: Retrieve foreground Session drains currently owned by this OpenNovel process. Sessions absent from the result are inactive.
Retrieve a session by ID.

Switch the model used by subsequent provider turns.
Durably admit one session input and schedule agent-loop execution unless resume is false.
Compact a session conversation.
Wait for a session agent loop to become idle.
Stage or move a reversible session boundary and optionally apply its file changes.

get.description: Retrieve the active context messages for a session (all messages after the last compaction).
Read one finite page of public durable Session events after an exclusive aggregate sequence. Newly committed events may appear on later pages.
Replay durable events after an aggregate sequence, then continue with new durable events.

post.description: Interrupt active execution owned by this OpenNovel process. Idle interruption is a no-op.

get.description: Retrieve one projected message owned by the Session.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

Retrieve saved permissions, optionally filtered by project.

200.description: 项目级写作模式与初始化模式

get.description: 读取 .novel/config.json 中的 writing_mode / setup_mode；文件不存在时返回默认值。

200.description: 项目级写作模式与初始化模式

put.description: PATCH 语义：仅修改入参中显式给出的字段，其余字段保持原值。

get.description: 列出项目技法库中的全部技法，返回顺序按置信度和更新时间排序。

post.description: 人工创建技法；未显式给出的字段使用默认值。

200.description: 项目级技法注入开关；false 表示保持 shadow 模式

get.description: 读取项目级技法配置：注入开关（缺失或非法值视为开启）。

200.description: 项目级技法注入开关；false 表示保持 shadow 模式

put.description: 更新 .novel/config.json 的技法注入开关（technique_injection）。

get.description: 获取单条技法内容和反馈记录。

put.description: PATCH 语义更新技法；confidence 和使用统计由既有闭环维护。

delete.description: 删除技法及其反馈记录。

get.description: Get the library-level cloud sync status for the configured root directory.

post.description: Test a WebDAV connection without saving it.

put.description: Test, then persist the cloud drive connection. The password goes to the credential store.

delete.description: Remove the cloud drive connection and credential.

put.description: Set the local working root directory. Every non-hidden subdirectory containing .novel/ is a synced project.

post.description: Sync the whole library: newer content wins on both directions; ambiguous cases come back as decisions.
Execute a single decision item (keep local/remote/both, confirm deletions, or skip).

TechniqueLibrary.description: 技法库范围：book=本书库（缺省）；global=全局通用库；all=双库合并

status.description: Current status of the task: pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled

priority.description: Priority level of the task: high, medium, low

answers.description: User answers in order of questions (each answer is an array of selected labels)

Novel.WritingMode.description: 写作模式：auto = 全自动写完直接推进；review = 每章写完置 pending_review 等用户审批

Novel.SetupMode.description: 初始化模式：interactive = 与用户讨论并呈现方案，确认后才落库；auto = 直接落库

Novel.NovelMode.description: 项目级写作模式与初始化模式

Novel.NovelModePatch.description: 模式设置入参，仅指定需要修改的字段

Novel.TechniqueLevel.description: 技法作用层级：段落 / 句子 / 对话 / 描写 / 过渡

Novel.TechniqueStatus.description: 技法状态：unverified / verified / shadow / archived

Novel.TechniqueScope.description: 内容性质：general=通用写法（入全局库跨书共享）；adult=成人内容（留本书库）

Novel.TechniqueInjection.description: 项目级技法注入开关；false 表示保持 shadow 模式
